summary: SCRTD disputed LAPD's estimate of 195 sworn officers, citing comparable transit systems (e.g., Chicago at 1.8 officers per station) to argue that SCRTD's proposed 2.6 officers per station plus full-time station attendants would provide adequate public safety, and only SCRTD's lower cost estimate is used in the project cost figures. A coordinated security plan would be developed with the City during Preliminary Engineering.
text:
The experience of other rail transit properties does not, however, support the City Police Department's proposal. Chicago is the best example to use. There, the City does the entire job under contract to the transit authority, and they require an average of only 1.8 policemen per station. It would appear, therefore, that SCRTD proposed 2.6 per station, plus a full-time station attendant, would provide adequate public safety, and only this number is used in the cost estimates.
    In conjunction with Preliminary Engineering the City and District would develop a coordinated security plan.

closing_anchor: In conjunction with Preliminary Engineering the City and District would develop a coordinated security plan.
